digest.component_or_area: code-review gate batch assembly and runner
propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner.run currently iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with prompt_id but no logical criterion_id, preventing activated project criteria from entering Round A/B workflow.

Project criteria must be resolved at batch assembly time in gate_dispatch.py by reading registry.effective_criteria and registry.effective_routing to select active LLM-tier project entries and resolve their physical prompts.

Project criteria entries must execute exactly once in Round A only (when req.step_id == 'round_a') and never in Round B, with findings appended logical criterion_id while preserving existing tags and reviewer_id.
Missing or malformed project criterion prompts must fail loudly with located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path, never silently degrading to built-ins.
An overlay-absent repo must produce unchanged ordered built-in Round-A and Round-B requests and findings with no project entries present, maintaining backward compatibility.
